prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A single, prominently placed can of Monster energy drink stands upright at the center of the composition, its matte black surface emblazoned with the iconic neon green claw logo. The can is labeled with the bold, unconventional flavor "Cheese & Onion" in striking yellow-orange text, immediately drawing the viewer’s attention. Wisps of vivid green vapor or steam rise dramatically from the top of the can, swirling upward and diffusing into the dark, moody background, suggesting an intense, almost supernatural aroma.

Surrounding the can are key ingredients that reinforce the flavor theme: a wedge of Swiss cheese with characteristic holes sits to the left, its rich yellow color contrasting against the black backdrop. In the foreground, a whole brown onion and a halved red onion are artfully arranged, their glossy skins and crisp, layered interiors rendered in sharp detail. A light dusting of salt or powder is scattered across the dark surface, adding texture and a sense of realism.

The lighting is cinematic and high-contrast, with a focused spotlight illuminating the can and ingredients, creating dramatic highlights and deep shadows. The background is a soft, out-of-focus black, ensuring all attention remains on the central subjects. The overall style is hyper-realistic with a touch of surrealism, emphasizing the boldness and unexpected nature of the product. The camera angle is slightly low and close-up, enhancing the can’s dominance and the intensity of the scene, while a shallow depth of field keeps the background blurred and the foreground elements crisp and vivid. The color palette is dominated by blacks, greens, yellows, and earthy tones, creating a visually striking and memorable image.
